answer_1.quote: PROXYQA evaluates the knowledge coverage and informativeness by checking if generated contents contain sufficient information to answer a set of proxy questions.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form reports or articles generated in response to meta-questions

answer_2.quote: we calculate the evaluator's average accuracy to represent the generated content's overall quality.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 and its variant, GPT-4-Turbo (GPT-4-1106-Preview), are utilized as evaluators.

answer_4.quote: Five well-educated postgraduate students are engaged; all have not participated in annotating the meta and proxy-questions of PROXYQA; they are required to score and rank the randomly sampled reports.
answer_4.guideline: Please rate the knowledge coverage of the reports provided, using a scale of 0-5. Assess how well the report covers the necessary information related to the question.
